display.title: Episode 354: The Secret Tunnel (Chanukah)
display.summary_short: A Chanukah show: mitzvah charts, a sing-along of Chanukah songs in three languages, a family says the Shema, and the story of a menorah that hid a secret tunnel.
display.summary_long: Broadcast during Chanukah 5749. Uncle Yossi reminds Tzivos Hashem soldiers to fill in the Chanukah mitzvah charts from the newsletter, with bonus points for inviting someone who has no menorah. A guest singer leads a Chanukah sing-along: Maoz Tzur, I Have a Little Dreidel, the Hebrew Chanukah, Chanukah, and the Yiddish Oy Chanukah. Three young brothers and their parents visit Studio 604 to say the Shema. Story time is The Secret Tunnel: an old shammes lovingly polishes the shul's huge brass menorah and finally reveals why. Long ago, when armed hooligans surrounded the shul and gave the people ten minutes to live, the rabbi said Tehillim, turned an arm of the menorah, and opened a secret door to a tunnel that led everyone to safety. After a sponsor message, a girl's letter asks to say the Shema on the radio. Uncle Yossi closes with the lasting message of the Chanukah lights, 'here comes Moshiach', and Friday's candle time for Shabbos Rosh Chodesh Teves.
display.lesson: Hashem is a G-d of miracles in every generation; trust Him, and keep the light of Chanukah with you all year.
